summary: The note describes the Poseidonion Grand Hotel, a luxury hotel in Greece that is considered one of the most luxurious in southeastern Europe. It sits on the island of Spetses, where it has been a landmark for nearly a century. Its architecture is noted for echoing hotels in the Côte d'Azur style.
one_line: The Poseidonion Grand Hotel is a luxury landmark hotel on the Greek island of Spetses, known for its Côte d'Azur-style architecture.
key_facts: The Poseidonion Grand Hotel is a luxury hotel in Greece.
The Poseidonion Grand Hotel is considered one of the most luxurious hotels in southeastern Europe.
The Poseidonion Grand Hotel is located on the island of Spetses.
The Poseidonion Grand Hotel has been a landmark on the Spetses skyline for nearly a century.
The architecture of the Poseidonion Grand Hotel echoes hotels of Côte d'Azur style.
